label: Practice issue in a fictional workspace; no submission to the City of Toronto

issues.text: [Practice] A deep pothole has formed near a pedestrian crossing on Bloor Street West. Could the road surface be checked?
[Practice] The curb ramp near a school crossing is blocked after construction. A wheelchair user has to enter the road to get around it.
[Practice] The shelter at a bus stop on Eglinton Avenue is missing route information. Please review how riders can find current service details.
[Practice] Recycling bins on our block were missed twice this month. Can the collection route be checked?
[Practice] The drinking fountain in a neighbourhood park has stopped working. It would help to know when it can be inspected.
[Practice] Water pools across a sidewalk after ordinary rain near a storm drain. Please check whether the drain is blocked.
[Practice] The accessible entrance at a public library is difficult to find from the street. Could wayfinding signs be reviewed?
[Practice] A streetlight is out along a walking route beside a park. Please inspect the lighting after dark.
